shortDescription: List and filter on Linode Interface Firewalls.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Linode Interface Firewalls to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Linode Interface Firewalls.

options.name: interface_id
options.description: The parent Linode Interface for the Linode Interface Firewalls.

options.name: linode_id
options.description: The parent Instance for the Linode Interface Firewalls.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Linode Interface Firewalls in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Linode Interface Firewalls by.
